newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-General Cigar Q2 shr rises to $0.22.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-General Cigar Q2 shr rises to $0.22.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

The outstanding share number is based on the number of class A and B common share and equivalents outstanding after the intitial public offering of class A common stock, which took place Feb. 28, 1997.
The company said it is exploring further produciton capacity expansions beyond its earlier plans, which could come on line sometime in 1998.
The company also said tobacco costs are rising because of supply and demand issues, which could have the potential of moderating margin growth in the future.
Before General Cigar Holding Inc's initial public offering, it was a wholly owned subsidiary of Culbro Corp. A previously approved merger of Culbro into General Cigar is scheduled for early 1997.
